content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] and an additional [product_name] module [article_no]. I'm unsure if the module is faulty because only input I10 is responsive, while the other inputs do nothing. Am I missing a selection in the hardware list of [product_name] software? The outputs Q5, Q6, Q7, and Q8 work correctly when triggered by I10. Appreciate any suggestions!
How did you test inputs I9, I11, and I12? Did you just touch a wire to the terminals, or did you insert the wire fully and tighten the screws?

analysis.insight_summary: A user has trouble with a [product_name] expansion module, where only one input terminal (I10) responds as expected and others do not. It is unclear whether the issue is due to a hardware fault, incorrect software configuration, or the way wires are being connected to the terminals. Another user has suggested checking the physical connection method as part of the troubleshooting steps.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that all inputs on the [product_name] module will work reliably and appear in the [product_name] software, without requiring any special configuration or extra steps for hardware setup.
